param_input_item.param_description: a string: Parquet file to inspect.

description.p: nelson.io.parquet.ParquetInfo stores metadata returned by parquetinfo.
Properties are Filename, FileSize, NumRows, NumVariables, NumRowGroups, RowGroups, Variables, CreatedBy, and dependent property VariableNames.
RowGroups is a table with row group metadata. Variables is a structure with variable names, Parquet types, and compression information.
